mapper.select: SELECT ar.request_uuid, ar.org_uuid, ar.request_type, ar.requester_uuid, ar.requested_seat_tier, ar.details, ar.status, ar.created_at, ar.resolved_at, u.email AS requester_email, NULLIF(u.name, '') AS requester_name, u.role AS requester_role, CAST(NULL AS text) AS requester_seat_tier FROM admin_requests ar LEFT JOIN users u ON u.uuid = ar.requester_uuid AND u.organization_uuid = ar.org_uuid AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ar.org_uuid = #{params.OrgUUID} AND ar.request_type = #{params.RequestType} AND ar.status = #{params.Status} ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC, ar.request_uuid DESC LIMIT #{params.Limit}
